channel.title: Comments on: Why I asked Santa for a Crepe Maker?
channel.description: Insights from work, home, and fatherhood and how they all mix together

item.title: By: Monica Husnay
item.dc:creator: Monica Husnay
item.description: Oh I will never forget that morning...we had a sleepover the night before... ofcourse Karen was throwing a fit at the table because Mr Mauro added pork and beans to the breakfast pancakes, so she was sent to her room ... meanwhile I was left at the table with the other Mauro kids pouring pineapple syrup on top! Love the Mauro family We will Always be deeply connected..
item.content:encoded: Oh I will never forget that morning…we had a sleepover the night before… ofcourse Karen was throwing a fit at the table because Mr Mauro added pork and beans to the breakfast pancakes, so she was sent to her room … meanwhile I was left at the table with the other Mauro kids pouring pineapple syrup on top! Love the Mauro family ❤️ We will Always be deeply connected..
